title: VisualSpec
description: Tool-agnostic intermediate representation of a single visual slot. Adapters translate this to platform-specific output (PBIP JSON, Metabase card, Grafana panel, …).

id.description: Slot identifier matching UseCase_Bracket slot names

visual_type.description: Tool-agnostic visual type from UseCase_Bracket vocabulary

page_role.description: Which page layer this visual belongs to

title.description: Optional display title for the visual

kpi_id.description: Source KPI ID from the KPI catalog

action_code_id.description: Source action code ID if visual is action-related

annotations.description: Explicit annotations on the primary visual (DoD #11). At least one required on Main_1 unless annotation_waiver is set. Authority: Knaflic, Storytelling with Data (2015), p. 173.

label.description: Annotation text displayed on the visual

anchor.description: Data point anchor: 'inflection', 'endpoint', 'max_deviation', 'threshold_crossing', or a specific date/value string

x.description: Canvas x position (0.0–1.0 fraction) when manually placed

y.description: Canvas y position (0.0–1.0 fraction) when manually placed

ibcs_scenario.description: IBCS scenario encoding for this visual series. Drives fill/shape rendering: ac=solid, pl=outlined, fc=hatched, py=50%-tint. Authority: IBCS Institute, Solid/Outlined/Hatched (2020).

Position.description: Canvas-fraction position. All values are 0.0–1.0 ratios of canvas dimensions.

Binding.description: Data binding for the visual. All names are human-readable; adapters resolve table references.

category.description: Category axis column. Format: 'table.column' or just 'column'

sort_by.description: Default sort column or measure name
